____rvmn: On Day 9, Pavel Rvmn arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

Pavel Rvmn did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Pavel Rvmn fired back. Teodor Bangarang was grazed. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Pavel Rvmn helped stack spare sandbags at R-R2. Nobody asked when they would be needed. A letter from home found Pavel Rvmn before the night shift. Pavel Rvmn folded it small and kept it close.

The sergeant at R-R2 called out a range and a spot. Pavel Rvmn was the only one who hit it. Dietrich "Tin" King was grazed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Pavel Rvmn is number 980. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Pavel Rvmn watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Pavel Rvmn asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-R2 and grazed Pavel Rvmn's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Ivo "Rabbit" Beck of the Hegemony (@brandon_marc_beck).

Pavel Rvmn returned to R-R2 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. A letter from home found Pavel Rvmn before the night shift. Pavel Rvmn folded it small and kept it close. After what happened at the Drowned Farm, Pavel Rvmn asked to serve as a chaplain. Nobody argued.
Pavel Rvmn buried two men at the edge of Lantern Hill and said the words twice, because the shells interrupted the first time.

Pavel Rvmn held a service beside a ration store. The men sang quietly so the sleepers behind the wall could rest. There was a letter for Pavel Rvmn and a little tobacco folded inside. The tobacco went round the squad. The letter did not.
agiraffedog: Otto "Ghost" Agiraffedog reported to S-S10 with a bullet that missed him sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
The dugout roof dripped into Otto "Ghost" Agiraffedog's mug. He moved the mug. The roof found another way.
The machine gun jammed at the worst moment. Otto "Ghost" Agiraffedog cleared it with a bent nail and words the chaplain pretended not to hear.
A bucket appeared above the Hegemony parapet at the Brickworks. Otto "Ghost" Agiraffedog fired. Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.'
Otto "Ghost" Agiraffedog shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.

A single shot from across the wire hit Otto "Ghost" Agiraffedog in the thigh at S-S10. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Dietrich Emfrulla of the Hegemony (@emfrulla). Otto "Ghost" Agiraffedog was hit at S-S10 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Dietrich Emfrulla of the Hegemony (@emfrulla).
The papers connected Marek "Brick" Agiraffedog to Otto "Ghost" Agiraffedog. The men took longer to learn Marek "Brick" Agiraffedog's own habits, but they made the effort.

A man asked Marek "Brick" Agiraffedog to describe Northwick without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch. The clerk counted the names twice. Marek "Brick" Agiraffedog is number 401 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In S-S10, Marek "Brick" Agiraffedog listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
A bullet went through Marek "Brick" Agiraffedog's sleeve at S-S10 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Roland "Lucky" Huncho of the Hegemony (@llsj_9huncho).
Marek "Brick" Agiraffedog no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Marek "Brick" Agiraffedog was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
Marek "Brick" Agiraffedog reached up to fix a sandbag at S-S10 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Karel Mccauley of the Hegemony (@parker.j.mccauley).
The medic cut the last bandage off Marek "Brick" Agiraffedog's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to S-S10 the same hour.
aki_pejo01: By the time Ivo Pejo reached S-C6, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Ivo Pejo moved to a new hide at S-C6 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Emil Awan, grazed. Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Ivo Pejo could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Benedikt Johnson of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Ivo Pejo kept the tin. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Ivo Pejo is number 820. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Ivo Pejo during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A dummy head on a stick drew the enemy's eye at S-C6. Ivo Pejo saw where the answering shot came from and fired back. Emil Roryhacon was badly wounded. A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Ivo Pejo aimed a step ahead and fired: Zeno Hop, grazed. A shell burst directly over S-C6. Ivo Pejo was found under the duckboards, alive, but only just. Ivo Pejo has a bed in the hospital dugout at last, between a man who prays and a man who swears. He says it is a fair balance. The worst has passed for Ivo Pejo. The surgeon says he will live, though not quickly.
Ivo Pejo wrote half a letter home from bed, then tore it up. It said he was fine. It was not a convincing lie.
Ivo Pejo returned to S-C6 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
Ivo Pejo and Quentin "Crow" Alpharius argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
A parcel from home held a comb. Ivo Pejo has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
baronpapas_hobbybunker: Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in Q-F13 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker was hit in the forearm at Q-F13. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft of the Concord (@brouwer_airsoft). Victory at Blackwater Canal. Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

The medics cleaned Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at Q-F13. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Pavel Olivas was grazed. Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker ate breakfast without a word.
A man asked Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker to describe Coldwater without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.

Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at Q-F13. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Karel Izaya of the Concord (@ronin_izaya).
Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at Q-F13. Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Marek Brycetom of the Concord (@brycetom03).
Viktor "Spark" Hobbybunker asked about Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker on arriving at Q-F13. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
cameron_sully: Emil Sully walked into T-F18 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Emil Sully wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Rafael Lm (Hegemony) watched Emil Sully (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at Sorrow Copse, and held fire until both were gone. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Emil Sully wrote to a sweetheart who has stopped writing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Emil Sully. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
Emil Sully fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Isidor "Doc" Slick, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Emil Sully waited for that to change. When it did, Severin "Mud" Goat was badly wounded.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Emil Sully put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
Water rose to the second step of the dugout. Emil Sully moved a pressed cornflower to the highest shelf and sat beside it like a guard.
charles_cvr_reyes: Karel Reyes joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Karel Reyes heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Karel Reyes began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Karel Reyes answered to number 914. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In R-R14, Karel Reyes listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Edmund Dreamskyi of the Hegemony shouted across the wire at the Hanging Bridge, asking for the football scores from home. Karel Reyes of the Concord shouted them back. Some of them were even true.
Karel Reyes got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
Karel Reyes fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-R14. Clement Wanter was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Word of Karel Reyes's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation.
Karel Reyes spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points.
dobremateiconstantin: Walter "Mole" Dobremateico found a place in S-S17 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Walter "Mole" Dobremateico tried to remember the price of a loaf in Dunmarrow. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Walter "Mole" Dobremateico aimed a step ahead and fired: Wendel "Brick" Chickenmcnug, badly wounded. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Walter "Mole" Dobremateico stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

During a lull at the Chalk Pits, Walter "Mole" Dobremateico called across from the Concord line. Walter Goggles answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet. Walter "Mole" Dobremateico got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 599. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Walter "Mole" Dobremateico wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Walter "Mole" Dobremateico aimed just below it. Norbert Cheese was badly wounded. A bullet went through Walter "Mole" Dobremateico's sleeve at S-S17 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Bram "Parson" Wyatthohbein of the Hegemony (@wyatthohbein).
Walter "Mole" Dobremateico no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
A grenade burst short of the parapet at S-S17. Walter "Mole" Dobremateico took a splinter in the hand and was bandaged where he stood.
Walter "Mole" Dobremateico rejoined the squad at S-S17. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Walter "Mole" Dobremateico was hit in the foot through his boot at S-S17. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Nils Weyer of the Hegemony (@wout.vd.weyer).
dreamskyi53736363: Edmund Dreamskyi took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Edmund Dreamskyi did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Edmund Dreamskyi dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Edmund Dreamskyi answered to number 926. Edmund Dreamskyi walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Edmund Dreamskyi of the Hegemony shouted across the wire at the Hanging Bridge, asking for the football scores from home. Karel Reyes of the Concord shouted them back. Some of them were even true.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Edmund Dreamskyi. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
Edmund Dreamskyi and Karel Engel compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
Edmund Dreamskyi sorted the dressings by lamplight. When the next stretcher arrived, he could find everything without looking.
Edmund Dreamskyi failed to return from the wire. A search found tracks leading into churned ground and nothing certain beyond it.
giannismg6: The new sniper gave his name as Gideon Giannismg. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Gideon Giannismg helped stack spare sandbags at R-C3. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Felix Landon and Gideon Giannismg divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion. Gideon Giannismg got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 783. The men who came later will ask about it. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-C3 with the rations. Gideon Giannismg ate while listening to the revised orders.
Gideon Giannismg began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
Gideon Giannismg sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line.
The east wind brought the smell of the other trenches: smoke, lime and somebody's cooking. Gideon Giannismg was hungry and furious about it.
Word of Gideon Giannismg's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation.
Gideon Giannismg reached up to fix a sandbag at R-C3 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Ulrich Unstoppable of the Hegemony (@mr.unstoppable213).
henrialexandrow: Valentin Henrialexand walked into S-S14 on Day 8 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

Valentin Henrialexand took the long way round Sorrow Copse because the short way had a sniper on it. The long way had two. Mail came up the line with a letter for Valentin Henrialexand. Valentin Henrialexand read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Valentin Henrialexand helped stack spare sandbags at S-S14. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Valentin Henrialexand mended the hole in Tobias "Brick" Blakeg's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Brick says the patch is stronger than the trousers. The clerk counted the names twice. Valentin Henrialexand is number 525 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is lost. Valentin Henrialexand heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Valentin Henrialexand took a wrong turn at two identical trench junctions. He decided the route needed names that could be remembered under pressure.
A new trench junction cost Valentin Henrialexand ten minutes. On the way back, he marked the right turn with a broken spoon.
Valentin Henrialexand marked the first junction with a spoon and the second with a boot sole. Other runners have begun using the names in their directions.
Valentin Henrialexand polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.
Valentin Henrialexand and Tobias "Brick" Blakeg carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
hunter_dorf0629: Konrad Dorf arrived on Day 6 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Konrad Dorf changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.

Konrad Dorf borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. A letter from home found Konrad Dorf before the night shift. Konrad Dorf folded it small and kept it close.

Konrad Dorf has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots. A letter from home found Konrad Dorf before the night shift. Konrad Dorf folded it small and kept it close.

Konrad Dorf went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Matthias Mart was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@frank_mart00) Konrad Dorf threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Karel Pavla was down and screaming for a medic. (@pavla.9_) Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Konrad Dorf could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. A letter from home found Konrad Dorf before the night shift. Konrad Dorf folded it small and kept it close.

Konrad Dorf read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing. Konrad Dorf got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 451. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Konrad Dorf helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

The dugout has begun inventing endings to Konrad Dorf's story. The cook's version involves an inheritance; the corporal's involves a disciplinary hearing. A letter from home found Konrad Dorf before the night shift. Konrad Dorf folded it small and kept it close.

Konrad Dorf (Hegemony) shouted a challenge across to Ivo Ursarte (Concord) at Grey Mill. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge. A letter from home found Konrad Dorf before the night shift. Konrad Dorf folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Konrad Dorf took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at R-S5, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. A letter from home found Konrad Dorf before the night shift. Konrad Dorf folded it small and kept it close. Konrad Dorf bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.' Konrad Dorf was invited to the Officers' Mess for keeping the front supplied. The colonel poured a real coffee and raised his cup: 'The front does not forget its friends.' A German shepherd came up the line with the ration party and would not leave Konrad Dorf's side. Konrad Dorf named the dog Shilling. The sergeant pretended not to see.

Konrad Dorf lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. A letter from home found Konrad Dorf before the night shift. Konrad Dorf folded it small and kept it close.

Konrad Dorf never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line. Konrad Dorf got a letter with a pressed leaf from the tree by the front door at home.
industriousbear: Day 9. The corporal put Matthias "Saint" Industriousb beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Matthias "Saint" Industriousb went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. A bullet hit Matthias "Saint" Industriousb's belt buckle at Q-F13 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Emil Sup of the Concord (@sup.0452). The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Matthias "Saint" Industriousb did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Matthias "Saint" Industriousb's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at Q-F13 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Matthias "Saint" Industriousb helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
A round went through the rim of Matthias "Saint" Industriousb's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Karel Izaya of the Concord (@ronin_izaya).
The medics cleaned Matthias "Saint" Industriousb's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at Q-F13.

Matthias "Saint" Industriousb was hit in the foot through his boot at Q-F13. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Emil Sup of the Concord (@sup.0452). The bearers reached Matthias "Saint" Industriousb at Q-F13 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Emil Sup of the Concord (@sup.0452).
Bram Industriousb came to the front because his cousin Matthias "Saint" Industriousb never came home. He carries a child's drawing of a horse.
Bram Industriousb fired at a movement across the wire at Q-F13. The man went down: Lucien "Ghost" Vikt, badly wounded.

Bram Industriousb was on the dawn watch at Q-F13 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Bram Industriousb was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Leopold "Tin" Jake of the Concord (@jake_81590).
m.montalvao_: The old hands of V-F10 have been here since Day 1. Severin Montalvao has been here since Day 11. In a trench, that difference already feels like years. Grey Mill is lost. Severin Montalvao heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Severin Montalvao agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
Severin Montalvao remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.

Severin Montalvao was hit in the forearm at V-F10. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Dietrich Notceyshhauc of the Hegemony (@notceyshhauceyban).
The medic looked at Severin Montalvao's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to V-F10. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at V-F10. Severin Montalvao was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Oskar Maxlheitzer of the Hegemony (@maxlheitzer).
The House of Montalvao sent another. Bram Montalvao, father of Severin Montalvao, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
newnario: On the way to R-F17, Viktor Newnario tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Viktor Newnario watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Dawn watch. Viktor Newnario put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram, grazed.
The party came back from Sorrow Copse by different routes. By dawn, everyone had been accounted for except Viktor Newnario.

The missing report was still on the desk when Viktor Newnario walked in. The clerk crossed it out hard enough to tear the paper. Victory at Hill 304. Viktor Newnario let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Viktor Newnario added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
Viktor Newnario and Clement Jewnipers carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
Viktor Newnario washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
Viktor Newnario tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.

Viktor Newnario was on the dawn watch at R-F17 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Viktor Newnario was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Yann Mixtapethepy of the Concord (@mixtapethepyromancer). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Viktor Newnario helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Viktor Newnario no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Viktor Newnario is number 144. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Viktor Newnario watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Viktor Newnario began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.

Viktor Newnario was hit through the chest at R-F17. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Rafael Official of the Concord (@deutsches_kaiserreich_official). A single shot at R-F17. Viktor Newnario sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Rafael Official of the Concord (@deutsches_kaiserreich_official).
Isidor "Hollow" Newnario had heard about Viktor Newnario's courage. At R-F17, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Isidor "Hollow" Newnario saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.

Isidor "Hollow" Newnario was carrying water up to R-F17 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Isidor "Hollow" Newnario did not. Shot by Felix Landon of the Concord (@landon59504).
There was never a bed for Isidor "Hollow" Newnario, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-F17 on his own feet.
schutze.neumann_: Benedikt "Mole" Neumann, a choir singer from Tannenfeld, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in T-F6. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Someone in T-F6 asked Benedikt "Mole" Neumann about Tannenfeld. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted. A letter from home reached Benedikt "Mole" Neumann before dusk. Benedikt "Mole" Neumann read it twice and slept a little easier. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Benedikt "Mole" Neumann during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Benedikt "Mole" Neumann fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Dorian "Rabbit" Obreezyz, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. A letter from home reached Benedikt "Mole" Neumann before dusk. Benedikt "Mole" Neumann read it twice and slept a little easier.

The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Benedikt "Mole" Neumann ate two helpings anyway. A letter from home reached Benedikt "Mole" Neumann before dusk. Benedikt "Mole" Neumann read it twice and slept a little easier.

Benedikt "Mole" Neumann had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Dorian "Rabbit" Obreezyz, grazed. A letter from home reached Benedikt "Mole" Neumann before dusk. Benedikt "Mole" Neumann read it twice and slept a little easier.

Benedikt "Mole" Neumann was made Lance Corporal after keeping the section together under fire. He asked that the rest of the section be mentioned too. A letter from home reached Benedikt "Mole" Neumann before dusk. Benedikt "Mole" Neumann read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dawn watch. Benedikt "Mole" Neumann put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Wendel Scottkurom, badly wounded. A letter from home found Benedikt "Mole" Neumann before the night shift. Benedikt "Mole" Neumann folded it small and kept it close.
slim_seif: Clement Seif walked into R-R10 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Clement Seif helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly. A letter from home reached Clement Seif before dusk. Clement Seif read it twice and slept a little easier.

A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Clement Seif lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Clement Seif helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Clement Seif wrote a letter for Hugo "Brick" Rhodehessner's mother, because Brick could not find the words. Brick signed it. A letter from home reached Clement Seif before dusk. Clement Seif read it twice and slept a little easier.
Jonas "Smokes" Ryx wrote a song about the Ossuary Wood. Clement Seif wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet found Clement Seif at R-R10, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. A letter from home reached Clement Seif before dusk. Clement Seif read it twice and slept a little easier.

There were too few medics and too many wounded. Clement Seif waited too long, and the wound grew worse for it. Clement Seif has a bed in the hospital dugout at last, between a man who prays and a man who swears. He says it is a fair balance.

Clement Seif's fever broke in the night. The orderly checked the chart twice and smiled for the first time in a week. A letter for Clement Seif came with a pressed flower inside. Clement Seif showed the flower to nobody.
the_ghost_of_sky: Severin Sky arrived at R-F9 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam corrected the cap; the first puddle corrected the rest.
Felix Varsikasikra taught Severin Sky to play the harmonica. The bay has asked them both, formally, to stop.
Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Severin Sky stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Severin Sky got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.

Severin Sky had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Jonas Miked crossed it, Severin Sky fired. Jonas Miked was badly wounded. A shell landed square in R-F9. They found Severin Sky alive under the sandbags, barely. Every minute counts now. Severin Sky died at his post at R-F9 when the dugout roof came down under a direct hit.
The House of Sky sent Casimir Sky after Severin Sky. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

Casimir Sky washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Casimir Sky did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
A bullet went through Casimir Sky's sleeve at R-F9 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar of the Concord (@max.kattawar).
A single shot from across the wire hit Casimir Sky in the thigh at R-F9. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Matthias Mart of the Concord (@frank_mart00).
There was never a bed for Casimir Sky, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-F9 on his own feet.
A flare lit Hill 304 like noon. Casimir Sky counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.

At R-F9 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Casimir Sky turned around and took a shovel blow. Isidor Liamroberts of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Isidor Liamroberts of the Concord (@liamroberts141). Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Casimir Sky could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Casimir Sky is whole again, or near enough for the line. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Casimir Sky answered to number 102. Grey Mill has been won. Casimir Sky listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Casimir Sky of the Hegemony and Gideon Wolves of the Concord have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at the Hanging Bridge. It is getting crowded.
Albin Ikanbili of the Concord lost a harmonica in no man's land at Lantern Hill. Casimir Sky of the Hegemony found it and has been learning the enemy's songs on it.
Casimir Sky (Hegemony) watched Jakub Fts (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at Hill 304, and held fire until both were gone.
A bullet found Casimir Sky at R-F9, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Wendel Schwols of the Concord (@erwin_schwols).
Casimir Sky waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Casimir Sky no longer needed it.
A letter came with Gideon Sky: "I am Casimir Sky's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
thepatrickbegley: Leopold "Spark" Thepatrickbe arrived at V-F12 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into V-F12. Leopold "Spark" Thepatrickbe has learned to walk bent double.
Leopold "Spark" Thepatrickbe tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
A flare caught Leopold "Spark" Thepatrickbe halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached.
The shelling stopped while Leopold "Spark" Thepatrickbe was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving.
A man asked Leopold "Spark" Thepatrickbe to sit nearby without saying anything. He stayed until the man fell asleep.
Leopold "Spark" Thepatrickbe kept Severin Houtarou awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Spark could have walked there blind.
vitocarcioppolo: Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp arrived on Day 4 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp kept watch so that Norbert Seamus could sleep. Then Norbert kept watch so that Mole could. Neither slept. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at S-F19 is closed now. A clear shot from S-F19. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp grazed Norbert Cheese and slid back down below the parapet. Hill 304 is lost. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Leopold Moodie fixed the strap on Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.
Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp won before reaching the end of his entry.

Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp landed next to Arno Dick in the Hegemony trench. Only Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp climbed back out. (@dick_j0b) Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp only heard boots on the duckboards at S-F19, then nothing but pain. Raider: Albin Weyer of the Hegemony (@wout.vd.weyer). The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp rejoined the squad at S-F19. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp answered to number 254. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached S-F19 with the rations. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp ate while listening to the revised orders.
A round went through Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Pavel "Crow" Scm of the Hegemony (@val_scm18).
Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp walked back up the communication trench to S-F19, slower than before, but on his own feet.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
A flare lit the Hanging Bridge like noon. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.

Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp went over with the raiders and dropped into the Hegemony trench. Henrik Small was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@ner_small) No rifles, only shovels and knives. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp dropped into the Hegemony trench by a dugout door and met Jonas Juizy coming out. It was over in seconds. (@juizy_44) A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at S-F19. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Wendel "Tin" Uwuandrea of the Hegemony (@uwuandrea_).
Dorian "Doc" Vitocarciopp asked about Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp on arriving at S-F19. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
xoromevert: Clement "Saint" Xoromevert came up on Day 10 carrying news from Halden. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired. Orders came through: Clement "Saint" Xoromevert is a machine gunner now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a stub of a pencil.

The mud froze hard overnight. For one morning Clement "Saint" Xoromevert could walk on top of it, like a man walking on water. A letter from home found Clement "Saint" Xoromevert before the night shift. Clement "Saint" Xoromevert folded it small and kept it close. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Clement "Saint" Xoromevert watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at P-F18 and grazed Clement "Saint" Xoromevert's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Florian Dcf of the Hegemony (@gian_dcf).

Clement "Saint" Xoromevert no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A letter from home found Clement "Saint" Xoromevert before the night shift. Clement "Saint" Xoromevert folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A round came through the loophole Clement "Saint" Xoromevert was watching at P-F18 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. A letter from home found Clement "Saint" Xoromevert before the night shift. Clement "Saint" Xoromevert folded it small and kept it close.
Clement "Saint" Xoromevert lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.

The medics called Clement "Saint" Xoromevert 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Clement "Saint" Xoromevert is back on the line. Clement "Saint" Xoromevert kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.
